title: Spatial Organization and Prognostic Significance of NK and NKT-like Cells via Multimarker Analysis of the Colorectal Cancer Microenvironment.
summary: Multiplex imaging plus supervised ML identified NK/NKT-like/T-cell populations and spatial relationships associated with colorectal-cancer survival. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: A multiplex immunofluorescence assay and digital image analysis/supervised ML quantified cell markers and distances to tumor cells.
